description: Modify global configuration settings of a FreeIPA Server.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: ipaconfigstring
parameters.description: Extra hashes to generate in password plug-in. Choices: "AllowNThash" "KDC:Disable Last Success" "KDC:Disable Lockout" "KDC:Disable Default Preauth for SPNs"

parameters.name: ipadefaultemaildomain
parameters.description: Default e-mail domain for new users.

parameters.name: ipadefaultloginshell
parameters.description: Default shell for new users.

parameters.name: ipadefaultprimarygroup
parameters.description: Default group for new users.

parameters.name: ipagroupobjectclasses
parameters.description: A list of group objectclasses.

parameters.name: ipagroupsearchfields
parameters.description: A list of fields to search in when searching for groups.

parameters.name: ipahomesrootdir
parameters.description: Default location of home directories.

parameters.name: ipakrbauthzdata
parameters.description: Default types of PAC supported for services. Choices: "MS-PAC" "PAD" "nfs:NONE"

parameters.name: ipamaxusernamelength
parameters.description: Maximum length of usernames.

parameters.name: ipapwdexpadvnotify
parameters.description: Notice of impending password expiration, in days.

parameters.name: ipasearchrecordslimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to search (-1 or 0 is unlimited).

parameters.name: ipasearchtimelimit
parameters.description: Maximum amount of time (seconds) for a search (-1 or 0 is unlimited).

parameters.name: ipaselinuxusermaporder
parameters.description: The SELinux user map order (order in increasing priority of SELinux users).

parameters.name: ipauserauthtype
parameters.description: The authentication type to use by default. The choice idp has been added in community.general 7.3.0. The choice passkey has been added in community.general 8.1.0. Choices: "password" "radius" "otp" "pkinit" "hardened" "idp" "passkey" "disabled"

parameters.name: ipauserobjectclasses
parameters.description: A list of user objectclasses.

parameters.name: ipausersearchfields
parameters.description: A list of fields to search in when searching for users.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Ensure password plugin features DC:Disable Last Success and KDC:Disable Lockout are enabled
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipaconfigstring: ["KDC:Disable Last Success", "KDC:Disable Lockout"]
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the default login shell is bash
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipadefaultloginshell: /bin/bash
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the default e-mail domain is ansible.com
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipadefaultemaildomain: ansible.com
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the default primary group is set to ipausers
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipadefaultprimarygroup: ipausers
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the group search fields are set to 'cn,description'
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipagroupsearchfields: ['cn', 'description']
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the home directory location is set to /home
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipahomesrootdir: /home
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the default types of PAC supported for services is set to MS-PAC and PAD
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipakrbauthzdata: ["MS-PAC", "PAD"]
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the maximum user name length is set to 32
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipamaxusernamelength: 32
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the password expiration notice is set to 4 days
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipapwdexpadvnotify: 4
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the search record limit is set to 100
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipasearchrecordslimit: 100
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the search time limit is set to 2 seconds
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipasearchtimelimit: 2
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the default user auth type is password
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipauserauthtype: ['password']
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the user search fields is set to 'uid,givenname,sn,ou,title'
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipausersearchfields: ['uid', 'givenname', 'sn', 'ou', 'title']
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

- name: Ensure the SELinux user map order is set
  community.general.ipa_config:
    ipaselinuxusermaporder:
      - "guest_u:s0"
      - "xguest_u:s0"
      - "user_u:s0"
      - "staff_u:s0-s0:c0.c1023"
      - "unconfined_u:s0-s0:c0.c1023"
    ipa_host: localhost
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: supersecret

return_values.name: config
return_values.description: Configuration as returned by IPA API. Returned: always
